description: Status, progress, and cost of one People Search task, plus a page of the people found so far: name, handle, url, platform, audience, location, fit score, why they matched, contacts, and links. Free. People arrive while the search runs: pass the returned next_cursor as cursor on the next call to get only the people found since then. When done is true and has_more is false you have everyone the search found.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous people-search-status call. Omit to start from the first person.

include_people.description: Set false to read only the status, progress, and cost.

name: people-search-status
title: Get People Search Status
